info.title: wellisearch
info.description: Web search backed by a local crawl index with live provider fallback, plus clean Markdown page fetching.

get.description: Searches the wellisearch local index first (fast, cached), then falls back to the live provider gateway (Tavily, Brave, SearXNG) in order. By default returns a Markdown document (text/markdown): a header with Source (local|tavily|brave|searxng|error) and Degraded (true|false), then result blocks of Title/URL/Snippet separated by --- lines. Local hits carry a Last Crawled line per result. After a non-local hit, result URLs are queued for background indexing. Set format=json (or send Accept: application/json) for the structured JSON envelope instead — the format param wins over the Accept header.

parameters.name: num_results
parameters.description: Number of results to return (default 5, max 20).

parameters.name: max_crawl
parameters.description: How many result URLs to queue for background indexing on a non-local hit (default 5).

parameters.name: max_age_days
parameters.description: Ignore locally indexed pages crawled more than N days ago (e.g. 7 forces a live lookup for stale pages).

parameters.name: skip_local
parameters.description: Bypass the local index entirely and force a live provider answer (use when unsatisfied with a prior local result).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format: markdown (default) or json. Wins over the Accept header.

200.description: Search results — Markdown by default; JSON when format=json or Accept: application/json.

application/json.description: Structured: source, degraded, count, timing{total_ms,index_ms,provider_ms?}, results[].

502.description: All providers failed and no local results exist. Body is the source=error envelope (Markdown or JSON per format).

post.summary: Fetch one URL as clean Markdown
post.description: Reads a single URL and returns clean, readable Markdown. Indexed pages are served instantly from the local index; unknown URLs are crawled on demand and stored. By default returns a Markdown document (text/markdown): a Title/URL/From Index/Chars/Truncated header, then the page body; a failed fetch returns a URL/Status/Error header. Set format=json (or send Accept: application/json) for the structured JSON envelope instead — the format param wins over the Accept header.

max_chars.description: Optional cap on returned characters (omit for the server default).

format.description: Response format. Wins over the Accept header.

200.description: Fetched page — Markdown by default; JSON when format=json or Accept: application/json.

text/markdown.description: Title/URL/From Index/Chars/Truncated header + Time line + page body.

application/json.description: Structured: ok, url, title, markdown, chars, truncated, from_index, timing{total_ms,index_ms,crawl_ms?}.

post.summary: Fetch several URLs in one call under a shared char budget
post.description: Reads multiple URLs and returns one combined Markdown document (one section per page), allocating a shared character budget across pages using the given strategy. By default returns a Markdown document (text/markdown): a Strategy/Budget/Pages Fetched/Total Chars/Truncated header, then one Title/URL/From Index/Chars/Truncated section per page (body after a --- line); failed URLs get a URL/Status/Error section. Prefer this over many fetch_page calls when you have several URLs. Set format=json (or send Accept: application/json) for the structured JSON envelope instead — the format param wins over the Accept header.

max_chars.description: Total character budget across all pages (omit for the server default).

format.description: Response format. Wins over the Accept header.

200.description: Combined fetch — Markdown by default; JSON when format=json or Accept: application/json.

text/markdown.description: Strategy/Budget/Pages Fetched/Total Chars/Truncated header + Time line + one section per page.

application/json.description: Structured: ok, pages_fetched, total_chars, strategy, budget, timing{total_ms,index_ms,crawl_ms?}, pages[].
